neco-2026-guidelines.title: Registration Guidelines for the 2026 Senior School Certificate Examination (SSCE) Internal
neco-2026-guidelines.documentReference: Local source: research/repo/NECO_2026 GUIDELINES.pdf; 7 pages. PDF metadata creation/modification 2026-01-22; not asserted as publication date.
neco-2026-guidelines.notes: Official NECO guidance explicitly for SSCE Internal 2026. All monetary values below are cycle-bound, and are historical as of 2026-11-01.

services.name: SSCE Internal registration fee
services.description: SSCE Internal registration fee documented for 2026 SSCE Internal examination cycle. This fee applies to the 2026 SSCE Internal examination cycle and should not be treated as a timeless NECO fee. The source lists the registration period as 19 January–25 May 2026 and late registration as 26–29 May 2026; these dates have elapsed.
requirements: School-based SS 3 candidates only; private candidates are excluded.
Candidate biodata, passport photograph in school uniform, subjects and 10-finger biometric data.
School portal access/claim and State Coordinator activation; signed validation documents as applicable.
processSteps: School accesses or claims its NECO portal using official school email and phone.
Install the 2026 offline application and enter candidate biodata including NIN; capture photograph and biometric data.
Validate candidate details offline, print photocards and validation list, obtain candidate signatures, and submit validation documents to the State Coordinator.
After school activation, pay into NECO TSA through the school portal/Remita and verify using the 12-digit RRR.
Upload selected candidates online; registration is complete only when online upload yields a registration number.
services.paymentGuide: For registration, pay into NECO TSA on Remita through the school NECO portal; verify payment using the RRR. Separate Stamp Duty, Service and Remita charges apply. For other fees/materials, follow the official school portal/State Coordinator route.
services.notes: This fee applies to the 2026 SSCE Internal examination cycle and should not be treated as a timeless NECO fee. The source lists the registration period as 19 January–25 May 2026 and late registration as 26–29 May 2026; these dates have elapsed. Applicant/payer category: candidate registration. Source page 4-5. Exact source wording: “₦30,000.00 only per candidate inclusive of Four-Figure Mathematical Tables and Waterproof Certificate Jacket/Folder.”
